name: calc_currency_converter
description:
Converts an amount between currencies at the latest rate from the open ExchangeRate-API endpoint (open.er-api.com); needs network access, no API key.
Returns {from, to, amount, rate, converted} (converted to 4 decimals), or {error} if the rate service fails or a currency code is unknown.
Inputs: from (ISO 4217 code; default USD), to (ISO code; default EUR), amount (number; default 1).
For FX quotes and history use fmp_forex_quote or fmp_forex_historical.
Example: {"from": "USD", "to": "JPY", "amount": 250}
